# `/connector-rules` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /connector-rules/v1

`getConnectorRuleListV1` — List connector rules

List existing connector rules.

- Scopes: idn:rule-management-connector:manage, idn:rule-management-connector:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 50 — default 50 — Note that for this API the maximum value for limit is 50. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.

- Returns 200: array of connectorruleresponse

### POST /connector-rules/v1

`createConnectorRuleV1` — Create connector rule

Create a connector rule from the available types.

- Scopes: idn:rule-management-connector:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): connectorrulecreaterequest
- Returns 201: connectorruleresponse

### GET /connector-rules/v1/{id}

`getConnectorRuleV1` — Get connector rule

Get a connector rule by ID.

- Scopes: idn:rule-management-connector:manage, idn:rule-management-connector:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the connector rule to get.
- Returns 200: connectorruleresponse

### PUT /connector-rules/v1/{id}

`putConnectorRuleV1` — Update connector rule

Update an existing connector rule with the one provided in the request body. These fields are immutable: `id`, `name`, `type`

- Scopes: idn:rule-management-connector:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the connector rule to update.
- Body (application/json): connectorruleupdaterequest
- Returns 200: connectorruleresponse

### DELETE /connector-rules/v1/{id}

`deleteConnectorRuleV1` — Delete connector rule

Delete the connector rule for the given ID.

- Scopes: idn:rule-management-connector:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the connector rule to delete.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /connector-rules/v1/validate

`testConnectorRuleV1` — Validate connector rule

Detect issues within the connector rule's code to fix and list them.

- Scopes: idn:rule-management-connector:manage, idn:rule-management-connector:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): sourcecode
- Returns 200: connectorrulevalidationresponse
